name: Masino1967 Image Filters Collection
author: Tommaso G. Scibilia

sections.description:
Additional filter effects for the Image block and the Featured Image block of the FSE block editor.
This simple plugin adds some image filters to the image block and featured image block. These are preset filters that add static color effects and hover color effects.
This plugin does not add new blocks to the editor but enriches the choice of filters available in the Styles section of the Image block and Featured image block of posts and pages.

sections.installation:
Option 1
1. Log into your WordPress admin panel.
2. Go to Plugins > Add New and search for Masino1967 Image Filters Collection.
3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Option 2
1. Download the plugin zip from WordPress.org.
2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
3. Upload the zip file and click Install Now.
4. Click Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I apply filters to my images?

Select the image in edit mode. Open the “Style” section of the “Image” block or the “Featured Image” block on the right side of the edit screen, and click on the name of one of the available effects.
